## What you want to do

A one-paragraph description of the use case. What are you building, and
where does open-distance not yet fit?

## What you'd ideally have

A specific API shape, field name, or behavior. Concrete proposals are easier
to evaluate than abstract ones.

## What you'd settle for

If there's a smaller win that would unblock you (a workaround, a partial
feature, a documentation change), call it out — that's often faster to
ship and may be all you actually need.

## Anything we should know about scope?

If your idea would expand coverage (other countries, walking/cycling modes,
live traffic, route geometry), please note that those are explicitly out
of scope for this project — see the FAQ on
[open-distance.com](https://open-distance.com/#faq) under "Can't do."
